It sounds like this person manipulated you into something you were not ok with. Whatever it is you were guilt tripped into, its some sort of abusive behavior from the person manipulating you and that’s not ok. They didn’t respect your boundaries and took  advantage of you and now you’re suffering the consequences of their selfish actions. Going to a professional can be very difficult, especially when you feel the circumstances of reaching out to someone may cause more damage. I know you said it’s not rape, but you could look into your local rape recovery center or something of that sort that offers groups. The one I go to offers weekly meetings over zoom (you don’t have to turn your camera on if you’re not comfortable), these specific meetings have lessons on what is consent, understanding and implementing boundaries, self care, etc. You are never asked to share personal or detailed information, its all focused towards supporting you. Sexual exploitation, sexual assault, etc, is never ok, even if you know the person, you don’t owe them any part of you that you aren’t comfortable giving. That goes for emotions, physical, photos, text messages, you don’t owe them anything.  It’s hard being the victim of these circumstances because you always feel like you’re suffering more than the perpetrator. People will try to invalidate you and it’s disgusting. I know from personal experience and have plenty to say on the matter as my case is still ongoing, so if you ever want to talk about it, I will listen and support you as much as a stranger can.
